description: The Water Survey of Canada (Environment and Climate Change Canada) produced HYDAT, the historical hydrometric database, with daily and monthly means, annual maxima and minima of daily means, and instantaneous peak water levels and discharges, plus sediment data, for all active and inactive stations. Coverage is Canada. The database is a free download from the Water Office, alongside real-time data, a desktop browsing tool and documentation of the Reference Hydrometric Basin Network of long, little-affected records for climate studies. Caveats: the page does not state how often HYDAT is refreshed, and real-time values come from a separate service. Simulation uses: flood frequency and drought hazard analysis and design flows for dams and flood defences. Related records: Canada's combined sewer overflow volumes (data-canada-wser-combined-sewer-overflow-volumes).
